integrity: The all-dimensional theorem is proved analytically from the discrete orthogonal-polynomial representation of the CG residual and the location of its Ritz roots. The sharp obstruction follows by a three-mode continuity argument. The embedded exact-rational verifier only replays displayed finite-dimensional witnesses.
scientific_limitations: Positive diagonal systems in the coordinate basis in which nonnegativity is tested; zero starting point; exact arithmetic. The quasi-Newton transfer assumes exact line search, identity initial Hessian approximation, and well-defined one-parameter Broyden updates. Nondiagonal systems, finite-precision loss of orthogonality, and nonzero starts are not classified.
title: Condition two is the sharp positivity frontier for conjugate gradients on positive diagonal systems
